verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a one-click install or app installation that grants Droid access to a user's repositories. Mentions of PR review, repository coverage, and Linear/Jira delegation imply that repos are connected somewhere, but none describe the access-granting flow or its ease. The axis applies to a coding-agent platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup
